item.text:
Audited all 29 Roman verses against the Urdu and corrected spelling, nasal vowels, izafat, and wording mismatches. The Urdu body and all other metadata are byte-for-byte unchanged.

The line containing `میںجا` still needs editorial sign-off. The Roman now reads `meiṅ ja`, following the written Urdu.
